title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - IncentiveTableProfile
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/IncentiveTableProfile. This flexibility profile describes the usage of an incentive table to describe an incentive type in the form of costs (relative or absolute), CO2 emissions or renewable energy percentage that can be associated to power values (expressed as a time-series of power data-points). Subclass of FlexibilityProfile per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityProfile model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'IncentiveTableProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isChangeable.description: Property. A relationship indicating that this element can be changed by its operator. The boolean value indicates whether it is indeed changeable. In the SAREF4ENER extension this property is intended for PowerLimits and IncentiveTable elements, such as the IncentiveTableProfile, IncentiveTableSlot, and the IncentiveTableTier.

requiresUpdate.description: Property. The relationship between the incentive table element and the boolean data indicating whether the incentive table requires an update. In the SAREF4ENER extension this property is intended for the following classes: - IncentiveTableProfile - IncentiveTableTier - IncentiveTableSlot

hasScopeType.description: Property. The relationship between the incentive table and the scope type Controlled vocabulary (ScopeType).

hasPowerPlan.description: Relationship. A reference to a power plan indicating the preliminary or committed usage of the energy smart device for a specific period. Relationship to PowerPlan.

hasTier.description: Property. The relationship between the incentive table and the tiers it consists of
